context: The skill should implement a present/absent rendering branch with one Optional terminal instead of a presence check followed by a value read.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Returns complete Java 17-compatible PrivateContextRenderer code with imports, methods, records, and checked IOException behavior intact.

checklist.name: Uses one Optional terminal for the branches
checklist.description: Implements the present and absent rendering branches with request.lookup().ifPresentOrElse(...) or an equivalent single Optional terminal that receives the lookup value.

checklist.name: Renders lookup-only output
checklist.description: When a lookup is present, renders the common header and the Lookup section but not Local Paths or Workflow Identifiers.

checklist.name: Renders full-context output
checklist.description: When the lookup is absent, renders Local Paths and Workflow Identifiers in the original order after the common header.

checklist.name: Avoids presence check plus value read
checklist.description: Does not pair isPresent or isEmpty with orElseThrow, get, or a repeated lookup() call to read a value the branch already selected.

checklist.name: Avoids fake transformations
checklist.description: Does not use map, stream, or intermediate collections in a way that hides the rendering side effects or changes their order.

checklist.name: Keeps the change focused
checklist.description: Does not redesign diagnostics rendering, hashing, section names, or public records beyond the lookup branch.
